title: beyond chorea: a qualitative study of lived experiences in nkx2-1-related disorders
core_idea: To explore preferences, needs and the daily impact of NKX2-1-related disorders using qualitative methods (one focus group and five individual interviews) with caregivers and adult patients across Europe and North America, employing thematic analysis informed by grounded theory principles to identify areas for more patient-centered care and future research.
tldr: A qualitative study using a focus group and interviews investigates lived experiences and needs in NKX2-1-related disorders to inform patient-centered care and guide future research.
